messages:
marta: draft idea 1 keyboard-first legend under the heatmap: a single row of focusable chips per route. chips show route name + compact sample badge. pressing ? while a chip is focused opens a lightweight explainer panel inline. mock: https://img.redwood.test/ux/legend-chips.png
derek: I like chips. keyboard nav detail: arrow-left/right moves between chips; Tab moves out of the legend. this keeps low tab pressure for keyboard users.
sophie: copy for chip sample badge: show fraction + percent, e.g. "1-in-20 (5%)". if sample_rate < 1 show an approx indicator: "1-in-20 (≈5%)" so it's clear metrics are estimated.
corrin: small accessibility note: when chip receives focus announce via aria-label: "Route payments-checkout, sampling 1-in-20 (approx 5%), p95 210ms". keep it concise.
marta: behavior for the ? key: open an inline panel anchored to the chip with: short explainer "Why sampled?" + actions: View traces, Override sampling (quick slider), Pin override. panel traps focus; Esc returns to chip.
derek: also make panel operable from click. ensure focus is restored to chip on close. add a small animated caret from chip to panel (no-motion respects).
sophie: p95 microcopy: inside panel show "p95: 210ms (computed from sampled data)" rather than saying just p95. clarity matters.
corrin: visual contrast: chips need a strong text contrast (4.5:1). propose token adjustments: chip-bg: neutral-100, text: neutral-900; sampled badge amber-600 with white text and 3px focus ring. test on dark theme too.
design-bot: note: analytics returns sample_rate (float) and sample_source. UI should render both when available ("1-in-20 (≈5%), client-sampled").
marta: mobile behavior: collapse legend into a "Legend" button; opening shows chips in vertical list with touch targets >= 44px and the same ? behavior via long-press to open explainer.
derek: QA checklist for PR: arrow-key navigation, Tab order, focus restore on panel close, ARIA labels for chips/panel, reduced-motion support, chip contrast in both themes, touch target sizing, analytics events for overrides.
sophie: one more nit: when user overrides sampling we should show a transient banner "Sampling override active on payments-checkout  Undo" and a small pill on the chip that says "override". ops wants audit logs for pin actions.
marta: perfect. I'll prototype the chips, add the ARIA labels and QA checklist, then open a PR with screenshots. tagging @derek @sophie @corrin :thumbsup:
